programme.title: TV 동물농장 스페셜

programme.title: 생활의 발견 스페셜

programme.title: 불후의 명곡 스페셜

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 大漢盛世首
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.desc: 六八年夏天，姓高紗廠老闆敗賭而致家破人亡他的八歲兒子高進從此喪失家園，加入了老千集團跟靳學一切千門技術，十七歲已成為獨當一面的老千高手後來在一次賭神大賽中被師父出賣，並遭槍擊，好友七姑娘與于於在混戰當中受了重傷，高進在連番打擊下決定與師兄傲及靳在賭場上決一死戰

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: 警署即將退休的黃局長因失去佩鎗，懷疑是遭曾到警署參觀的中學生偷走，遂暗中派飛虎隊員周星星（周星馳飾）及老牌臥底曹達華（吳孟達飾）潛入學校臥底伺機尋回失鎗在學校裡假扮父子的兩人與輔導老師何小姐（張敏飾）一班學生及黑社會勢力將會在校園中引起何等風波？

programme.title: 逃學威龍2
programme.desc: 周星星（周星馳飾）和曹達華（吳孟達飾）因立功得見上司黃蓮如（葉德嫻飾）研究升職事宜黃對達之正義勇敢極為欣賞，提升為重案組，但對星之輕浮不滿而調往當交通差達獲委以重任再度進入學校臥底調查恐怖分子活動，星亦以個人身份進入學校臥底協助達調查過程中，星發現一女孩Sandy（朱茵飾）可能與此案有關，故假意結識，怎料Sandy竟對星產生愛意，令已與何老師論及婚嫁的星進退兩難

programme.title: 龍馬精神
programme.desc: 昔日風光的龍虎武師老羅（成龍飾），如今窮困潦倒，與他的愛馬赤兔相依為命，在片場靠著跑龍套過日子老羅一心想將赤兔培養成動作巨星，然而天外飛來橫禍，老羅與赤兔無端身陷官司，只能求助於多年未見的女兒小寶與其律師男友乃華與此同時，有人上傳了老羅與討債集團的追逐戰影片，精彩的武打動作在網路瘋傳，老羅更獲得拍電影的機會，女兒小寶還幫忙當起了製作人，試圖為老羅與赤兔爭取最好的動作舞台

programme.title: 人潮洶湧
programme.desc: 小劇場演員陳小萌的人生窮困潦倒，事業一敗塗地，有一天，他去澡堂泡澡，竟意外的讓殺手周全摔倒失憶，演員和殺手交換了身分，從醫院醒來的殺手失去記憶，誤以為自己是走投無路的演員，在偶然結識的單親媽媽李想的幫助下，他重新認識作為演員的自己，探索前進的方向，在這過程中他和李想的內心也悄悄發生變化

programme.title: 記憶大師
programme.desc: 知名作家江豐正面臨與妻子張代晨的婚姻危機，為了不讓自己沉浸在過往，江豐來到了記憶醫療中心欲將過往的回憶取出，沒想到妻子卻要求他將記憶取回才願意離婚重新取回記憶的江豐，卻發現腦海中竟出現一場殺人回憶，江豐像是被捲入深不可測的陷阱中但，這份記憶真的正確嗎？

programme.title: 洗黑錢
programme.desc: 周律師是專門為香港黑道洗錢的中間人，為了獨吞一筆鉅額贓款，派出殺手對付美國來的客人大偉，經過一場激烈槍戰，大偉僥倖逃脱，錢箱卻不翼而飛退役警察游龍和律師余文慧意外被捲入這場風波並被誤認為是幕後黑手，為了證明清白，兩人在危險中攜手合作，與周律師展開一場驚天動地的對決

programme.title: 水滸笑傳
programme.desc: 顛覆水滸傳中武松的英雄形象！武松原乃膽小莽夫一名，但每當酒過三巡，便生出一身蠻力神勇無匹其兄武大郎與潘金蓮是一對鴛鴦大盜，以仙人跳為生無往而不利一日武大郎在街上遇到西門慶，欲故計重施而推薦潘金蓮，又恐生性正直的武松礙事，遂唆使潘金蓮用計趕走武松

programme.title: 西遊記之大鬧天宮
programme.desc: 玉帝大敗牛魔王後，女媧娘娘為求三界和平，願犧牲自我化身晶石築起南天門，卻遺落了一顆石頭化成孫悟空天資不凡的悟空跟隨菩提祖師修成七十二變，決心成為神仙，卻因桀驁性格被逐出師門，到了花果山自立為王落敗的牛魔王為重返天界，用計煽動孫悟空大鬧天庭，使玉帝不得不率領二郎神等眾仙迎戰，天庭再度陷入混亂之中

programme.title: 西遊記：女兒國
programme.desc: 唐僧師徒途經忘川河，因激怒河神而誤入西梁女界，國有祖訓，將男人視為天敵典籍中更預言，有朝一日，會有東土而來的僧人，帶著一隻猴子一頭豬和一個小藍人闖入其中，而他們到來之日，便是女兒國走向毀滅之時！

programme.title: 綁架者
programme.desc: 一起車禍意外，牽扯出一樁重案組警員林薇（白百何飾）女兒的綁架案，唯一的嫌疑人楊念（黃立行飾）因頭部受到撞擊喪失記憶，面對林薇的步步緊逼與不斷襲來的殺機，陷入迷局的楊念決定挽回自己的記憶隨著楊念重返綁架兒童販賣器官的組織逐漸想起的破碎記憶，他驚覺這一切，竟與追查此案的重案組組長陸然明道飾有著密不可分的關係，而整個警界更有著不可告人的黑暗面而尚未失去記憶前的自己，真實身分又是誰？

programme.title: 七劍
programme.desc: 滿清入關，中原武林仍隱藏不少反抗力量，親王派前朝降清高手剿殺各地武林異議人士，重要目標便是位於西北邊陲武莊內隱藏的反清組織天地會分舵人馬路見不平的俠醫傅青主帶領兩位武莊青年上天山求助於世外高人晦明大師，晦明大師答應相助，並將畢生修為煉成的七把寶劍分贈七人，展開七劍下天山的武林傳奇其中七劍分別為：一曰莫問二曰由龍三曰青幹劍四曰競星，五曰舍神劍六曰天瀑劍七曰日月劍

programme.title: 六扇門 13-15 首
programme.desc: 六扇門 13-15 首

programme.title: 賭神
programme.desc: 世界聞名的賭神高進（周潤發飾）在決戰前夕，跌下山坡導致失憶，幸得小流氓陳小刀（劉德華）照顧有加期間高進堂弟殺害高進女友，並派人追殺高進高進幾經波折後，與賭王陳金城競賽並贏得賭局，亦對堂弟之背叛成功復仇

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之怒海雄風首
programme.desc: 甲午戰敗，喪權辱國的馬關條約簽訂後，日本嚐到甜頭，又想吞併更多領土，軍機大臣張之洞以欽差大臣身份前往廣州整軍備戰，成為日本人眼中釘他們想擺平張之洞，又不敢明目張膽動手，於是以服部一郎川島雪姬為首的日本殺手秘密組織神奈社，買通白蓮教抓走張之洞黃飛鴻率眾徒們以身犯險營救張之洞，慢慢揭開日本人的陰謀

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘6：救贖之路
programme.desc: 恐怖份子首腦哈辛即將展開攻擊行動，戰狼部隊必須守護他們的秘密基地戰狼托米斯過往秘密揭曉，這群戰狼隨之將踏上未來救贖之途

programme.title: 追殺胖老爹
programme.desc: 聖誕老人克里斯（梅爾吉勃遜飾）隨著年紀增長，事業也跟著逐年下滑為了拯救聖誕工廠，並養活他的小精靈員工，他被迫與美軍合作，轉行開始製造軍武然而不過是一次失誤，竟讓他惹來殺身之禍？！原來就在聖誕節早晨，一位富家少爺滿心期待地打開聖誕禮物，卻發現禮物只是一塊煤炭，於是決定雇用職業殺手，獵殺這位讓他火冒三丈的聖誕老人！屁孩PK聖誕老人，這場佳節攻防究竟誰輸誰贏？

programme.title: 湯恩與劍客汪汪隊
programme.desc: 湯恩希望追隨父親的腳步，成為皇家劍客汪汪隊一員他前往巴黎冒險，遇見喋喋不休的老鼠皮普，並成了湯恩的隨從湯恩與貼身戰友經歷無數場戰役，不僅要力抗邪惡的紅衣主教及其黨羽，還要阻止英法爆發戰爭歷經了這些後，湯恩發現友誼和正義的寶貴價值湯恩最終能成為劍客汪汪隊的一員並贏得佳人的芳心嗎？

programme.title: 放牛班足球隊
programme.desc: 瑪麗娜是位相當不尋常的修女，她來到一所學校任職，學校收容許多單親失親的孩子她被分配到最不喜歡讀書的放牛班，孩子們一如既往地調皮搗蛋，想要逼退瑪麗娜修女儘管如此，瑪麗娜有個想法，想組建一支足球隊，幫助孩子們找到學習的重心

programme.title: 毀滅倒數
programme.desc: 不久的未來，漂泊的太空人大衛，正在外太空進行例行氣候視察一場失控的意外，讓大衛與太空船及地球指揮中心失去聯繫而此時的地球，機器人與人工智慧已經成為人們生活的好夥伴；科技的快速發展，讓人們可以重返並編輯自己過去的記憶租借身體，甚至高階的人類，更可以選擇讓自己長生不老只是，當仰賴的科技變成真實夢魘，世界即將在十分鐘內毀滅，人們還能掌控自己想要的未來嗎？

programme.title: 星光首映場戰爭中的鬼故事
programme.desc: 在二次世界大戰最黑暗的日子裡，五名美國大兵受命前往一座曾被納粹高級指揮官佔領的法國莊園當他們進入這座莊園後，竟開始經歷一連串難以解釋的靈異現象，讓他們的世界變得瘋狂這場難以脫逃的夢魘，似乎比戰爭所目睹事物都更加可怕

programme.title: 絕對逆襲
programme.desc: 麥克是懷有滿腔熱血與理想的年輕律師，但西裝筆挺的他私底下卻是個重度癮君子某天發生了一起醫護人員因公意外感染愛滋的案件，因為背後隱藏著政府司法及醫療體制構成的龐大秘辛，竟沒有任何一位律師願意為他們發聲為了正義，麥克毅然決然地挺身而出，遊走於黑暗與光明間的他，也被迫面對自己心中的黑洞

programme.title: 魔女神兵
programme.desc: 十四世紀的法國，貝曼（尼可拉斯凱吉飾）率領一群驍勇善戰的戰士，奉命押解一名被冠以女巫之名的女子上山，交由僧侶作法驅魔經過朝夕相處，戰士們對年輕女子的罪名產生懷疑和困惑，儘管世人堅稱巫女魔力是當時黑死病肆虐的根源，但他們依舊抱有懷疑勇士們遊走於任務與正義之間，友誼也因此受到空前考驗

programme.title: 毒梟通緝令
programme.desc: 美國黑幫頭子艾瑞克為打入墨西哥毒梟圈子取得信賴，殘忍地殲滅競爭對手但在一次運毒任務中被警察埋伏，才驚覺團隊裡有內鬼在找出內鬼的同時，艾瑞克與美國緝毒局探員以交換條件方式相互幫忙讓毒梟被逮，艾瑞克就得以獲得販毒豁免權一場美國黑幫墨西哥毒梟以及美國緝毒局之間的戰役即將展開

programme.title: 綁架
programme.desc: 知名律師派翠莎的兒子維克多從學校失踪，幾個小時後維克多再次出現，身上滿是淤青和汗水，聲稱有名男子試圖綁架他，但他成功逃脫大批員警展開搜索行動，在維克多的指認下，成功抓到嫌犯，但因證據不足，只能無罪釋放害怕兒子再次遭受危險的派翠莎，決定放手一搏，親自執行正義

programme.title: 好萊塢幕後解密新
programme.desc: 好萊塢幕後解密新

programme.title: 火力衝突
programme.desc: 二戰期間，歐洲最大的沃庫瓦爾戰役中，一名年輕的美國女性，試圖尋找一名過去出現在她生命中的男子這是一個關於信仰羈絆覺醒，和追求救贖與自由的故事

programme.title: 迫切救援
programme.desc: 在美國與墨西哥相接的邊境四個州之中，德州發生最多起非法移民死亡案件，邊緣城市受到毒品黑幫與人口販賣的威脅也層出不窮一名甫畢業的女孩在畢業晚會回家途中遭到綁架，她的哥哥萊恩必須與時間賽跑，要從專門販賣年輕女孩的人口販子手中救回妹妹，在她被人蛇集團吞噬並消失在這世界之前

programme.title: 玩命快遞：肆意橫行
programme.desc: 法蘭克馬丁卸下特務身分後，轉行成為地表最強送貨員，他的客戶通常是身分可疑的危險人物，不過他從不過問交易細節拿錢辦事而且絕對使命必達當退休的特工老爸來到南法找他時，原以為可以再續父子天倫之樂，沒想到老爸卻涉入蛇蠍美女安娜與其美麗同夥策劃的銀行搶案，法蘭克必須用他非凡身手與飛車絕技，救回最珍貴的家人！

programme.title: 潛龍突擊隊
programme.desc: 一群海豹突擊隊，在飽受戰爭蹂躪的東歐國家有東歐火藥庫的波士尼亞鎮守而駐守在這國家閒來發慌的五大神兵，聽聞近郊湖底埋著價值美金三億的黃金，他們私下出動直升機秘密偵測開坦克橫行街頭，只為揭開隱藏的巨大寶藏

programme.title: 單車總動員
programme.desc: 車輪市是一個住滿腳踏車的美麗城市，主角旋風是一台越野腳踏車，他的夢想是成為大家的領袖，維護城市的整潔沒想到某天城市裡竟然出現了汽油引擎，這些吵雜又會排放廢氣的引擎徹底影響了大家的生活，快快必須與夥伴齒輪和孟塔娜一起對抗這些可惡的汽油引擎，讓車輪市恢復乾淨美麗的模樣

programme.title: 星際特工瓦雷諾：千星之城
programme.desc: 盧貝松執導科幻作品瓦雷諾與蘿琳娜是時空旅行特務的精英成員，他們不斷在時間與空間中穿梭，維護28世紀的世界秩序兩位特工搭檔意外捲入巨大的星際陰謀，從而引發一場關乎7000多個宇宙種族存亡之戰

programme.title: 野性獵殺
programme.desc: 特種部隊退役的法蘭克以販賣野生動物為業，某日他在巴西捕獲了一隻兇猛罕見的白色美洲豹沒想到船運過程中，碰上美國國安局正押解危險重刑犯洛夫勒，洛夫勒逃脫國安局的監控，並釋放船上所有的野生動物，法蘭克必須設法活捉美洲豹，還得協助美國政府捉拿洛夫勒，一場船上惡戰即將展開

programme.title: 獵殺戰場
programme.desc: 為了拿下一項軍事標案，一家AI機器人製造商買通一名中央情報局探員，進行了一場未授權的非法武裝軍事行動他們將四個AI機器人原型放進亞洲金三角地區進行測試，但系統失控導致無辜居民遭到殺害原先為人道任務來到這裡的六名醫生，除了見證了殘酷的殺戮，自己也淪為武裝機器人的獵殺目標，該如何在這邊境叢林絕境中求得一線生機！？

programme.title: 日落黃沙
programme.desc: 20世紀初隨著鐵路貫穿美國東西部，傳統舊西部正在消失，由派克領導的搶劫集團決定幹下最後一票大搶案後收山，殊不知這是鐵路公司募集一群賞金獵人所設下的圈套事敗後倖存的五人越過邊境逃往墨西哥，墨國軍閥馬帕其提出豐厚條件請派克一夥去搶劫美軍的重武器為了金錢江湖道義與兄弟情誼，一場腥風血雨即將展開

programme.title: 花田囍事
programme.desc: 小霸王周通與妹周吉時常惹事淩人，其母太君為使二人定性，決要二人各自成親吉與指腹為婚的林嘉聲被迫入贅周家，林嘉聲於洞房夜逃走，巧遇母夜叉相助通找魔術師高柏輝於太君壽宴中表演，正值花田燈會中，輝邂逅白家獨女白雪仙，通偶然得睹雪仙芳容，驚為天人，硬要娶雪仙過門，於重重誤會下，弄成笑話百出

programme.title: 怪獸總進擊
programme.desc: 西元1999年，人類以高科技將地球十大怪獸集中在小笠原群島上，與人類和平共處某日黃色氣體籠罩全島，怪獸與控制中心的人類均不省人事不久後哥吉拉拉頓摩斯拉哥羅恐龍等怪獸在世界各國失控冒出大肆破壞！月光SY-3太空船被緊急派往月球探查，發現外星人弱點後化解危機；然而宇宙怪獸王者基多拉再次降臨，怪獸軍團們能否成功守護地球？

programme.title: 馬永貞首
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 逃出封鎖線
programme.desc: 二戰期間，一支德國坦克軍隊正在向莫斯科前進兩架戰機奉命前往阻止德軍進犯，空軍隊長尼古拉康姆列夫被迫降落在敵軍領地，歷經千辛萬苦後成功返回祖國，但也因傷送醫性命垂危他究竟是否能甦醒展開全新生活，迎接等待他的國家與戀人呢？

programme.title: 外太空九號計畫
programme.desc: 由於地球政府不願承認外星人的存在，並研發可能摧毀宇宙的太陽彈，於是外星指揮官啟動外太空九號計劃，準備讓活屍大軍進攻球所幸奉命調查的美軍上校轄區警長與目擊民航機師三人，與外星人在飛碟機艙內打鬥而造成失火，最終導致飛碟在逃離地球時於空中爆炸，這才適時解除危機！

programme.title: 伊莉莎白二世：榮耀年華
programme.desc: 伊莉莎白二世是在位最久的英國女王和大英國協君主她不僅在英國德高望重，對全世界而言，更是堅強剛毅與端莊的代表人人都能感受到她的和藹親切本紀錄片將帶您一窺伊莉莎白二世的全貌，包含了她的興盛榮譽和她痛失親人，歷經醜聞時的態度，全方位剖析她是如何從公主蛻變為受全球愛戴的一代女王

programme.title: 哥吉拉
programme.desc: 潛伏自侏儸紀的大怪獸哥吉拉，突然地出現在東京沿海造成嚴重死傷生物學家山根博士原主張不予攻擊，但在目睹遍地瘡痍後終於認同消滅哥吉拉的行動最後在科學家芹澤犧牲自己使用秘密的氧氣破壞裝置後，與哥吉拉一同葬送在大海中

programme.title: 葉問：終極一戰
programme.desc: 患有胃病的葉問，於1949年隻身前往香港謀生在港九飯店職工總會天台開始教授詠春的他，獲得了一班新收徒弟這班徒弟中，任職警察的鄧聲因鎮壓罷工的工人，被逼著與同門師弟妹梁雙李瓊陳四妹等人為敵葉問的妻子張永成，在這期間從佛山來港團聚，未料香港的生活讓夫妻倆的相守之路越陷艱難

programme.title: 血染雪山堡
programme.desc: 二戰中期盟軍重要人物－美國卡納比將軍，座機在德奧邊界墜毀被俘，就近被囚禁在阿爾卑斯山中地勢險惡的鷹堡英國軍情六處特納上校立即派遣以特工史密斯少校為首與美軍謝弗中尉等精通德語的七人突擊隊，假扮德軍深入敵營搶救但在空降時通訊士意外喪命，不久又有兩名成員離奇身亡，更離譜的是謝弗中尉從史密斯少校口中得知，卡納比將軍竟是由演員所扮演！這艱鉅的鷹堡搶救任務，究竟還隱藏著甚麼更大的陰謀？

programme.title: 馬永貞
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 大洪荒
programme.desc: 公元前百萬年的遠古時代，高原洞穴中的岩石部落，首領阿可荷巴的次子托馬克因不服父親搶奪自己的食物而遭驅逐，流浪至海邊被較文明的貝殼族所救他因奮勇擊退巨獸而為貝殼族所擁戴，並受該族美女羅安納仰慕，而後率領貝殼族人歷經千辛萬苦回到岩石部落，卻人事已非其兄長沙卡納謀害父親並繼任成為新的首領，而高原上的火山也即將爆發

programme.title: 633轟炸大隊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，挪威反抗軍領袖艾利克冒死劫機逃至英國，帶來德軍在挪威秘密研發飛彈準備對盟軍展開致命攻擊的情報英軍命令格蘭特指揮官的蚊式戰鬥轟炸機633中隊，執行摧毀德軍隱身在挪威險峻峽灣飛彈工廠的任務艾利克奉命返回挪威帶領反抗軍破壞保護工廠的防空陣地，卻不幸被蓋世太保所擄並遭嚴刑拷問；消息傳回英國，為避免任務曝光急命633中隊全員出動救援

programme.title: 馬永貞
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: 改編自金庸武俠小說倚天屠龍記父母雙亡的張無忌（李連杰飾）身中玄冥神掌，幸得明教聖女小昭（邱淑貞飾）相助，練成九陽神功與乾坤大挪移，爾後得悉蒙古郡主趙敏（張敏飾）欲殘殺明教之奸計，遂赴光明頂揭穿其陰謀，終成為明教教主

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 被告人首
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同完
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 2023紅星大獎獲最佳電視劇 自閉症家庭的家人間扶持溫馨勵志小品鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天

programme.title: 財閥家的小兒子
programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款! 尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛? 講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中夏娃的醜聞裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天邪門徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 落難千金嫁到三位惡婆婆家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪

programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 巴塔木特攻隊
programme.desc: 英國Calm Island公司出品，知名少兒頻道同時段收視冠軍寶座！在寧靜美麗的巴塔王國裏，巴塔和小夥伴們一起守衞巴塔木世界的和平在巴塔木之外的黑暗森林裏，出現了新的對抗者，他們需要集結所有隊員的勇氣才能阻止黑暗勢力因此他們發現問題，解決問題，並回顧總結之前發生過的事情，以期能次次運用團隊智慧解決困難，

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記

programme.desc: 今集，薩希帶我們去法屬波利尼西亞的博拉博拉島展開難忘的美食之旅透過可持續捕魚和捕捉黃鰭吞拿魚，探索波利尼西亞傳統他還去了島上的度假村，看艾力大廚用本地材料，結合法式烹飪技巧，創造出融合美食

programme.title: 七點半新聞報道英

programme.title: 天氣報告英 及 財經消息英
優遊假期英
programme.desc: 金馬倫和黛安娜結伴同遊泰國首先入住曼谷柏悅酒店，享受豪華美食和水療按摩又去當地市場試食新奇美食然後二人乘搭私人飛機去閣骨島，入住度假村，並享受一頓難忘的樹頂大餐

programme.title: 明珠絕色:野性中國英
programme.desc: 熱帶雨林在中國不普遍，但有中國夏威夷之稱的海南島卻是顯著例外，這裡擁有豐富熱帶雨林棲息地本集會介紹海南熱帶雨林國家公園令人嘆為觀止的全景，並探索鮮為人知的瑰寶，同時追蹤稀有和標誌性物種的蹤跡

programme.title: SALON de PRO 沙龍級 無味染白髮染霜 呈獻:明珠930:22世紀殺人網絡 復活次元英PG
澳洲滋味精選英
programme.desc: 一百多年來，澳洲人從烹飪書媽媽嬸嬸電視烹飪節目的廚師學習廚藝今集，崇明和阿寶來到澳洲的糧倉吉普斯蘭，了解澳洲人為何熱愛簡單的家常烹飪，並在美利因蒜頭節上炮製完美的烤羊肉

programme.title: 貼地鐵路遊英
programme.desc: 今集米高和韋爾來到新斯科舍省，探索其獨特且正宗的面貌他們在登上海洋號前，踏上卡伯特公路，去了解密莫族的文化生活他們還去找跑滾木冠軍狄倫進行伐木工比賽，然後去捕龍蝦和在加拿大的海洋遊樂場滑浪

programme.title: 穹蒼下的世界英

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英

programme.title: 狗狗老友記英

programme.title: 節拍小天地英

programme.title: 明珠絕色:野性中國英

programme.title: 優遊假期英

programme.desc: Mini 鄭秀文飾 是旅居日本的香港人,原本她是一名窈窕美女,但她在鋼琴家男友黑川到美國留學後,卻因孤獨貪吃逐漸變成了一個體重260磅的大肥婆.黑川學成歸來在日本各地陸續舉辦了多場鋼琴音樂會,Mini儘管每次都到場觀看,但是黑川已經認不出她了.這讓Mini非常自卑想要在旅館上吊自殺,被旅館女老闆阻止,並認識了在此旅館暫住的有相似體形卻過的很開心的肥佬 劉德華飾 --他也是名旅居日本的...

programme.title: 我們和牠們 第187集

programme.title: 石評天下 第174集

programme.desc: When Muffin is told that she is special by her Dad, she interprets it as an excuse to do anything she wants, which means playing Bluey and Bingos game of Library her way.

programme.title: Elephant, Animal with Special Feet
programme.desc: Finn and family discover how tall an elephant can grow to!

programme.title: How the Red Kangaroo Stays Cool
programme.desc: Bora and Brody get Pio to show feverish Finn how a kangaroos in the Australian outback keep cool in the heat.

programme.title: Andy and the Sea Otters
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to California, on the west coast of America, in search of a sea otter mother and pup that are living in a busy boating marina.

programme.title: The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. Its Duggees diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels arent sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Its a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggees cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. Theres a big match ahead...

programme.title: The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When theyre accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels havent been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggees help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Rolys imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds its time for some gardening!

programme.title: Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: Whats that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? Its the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Greens
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, LaaLaa and Po pick delicious green beans. The Noo-Noo puts the beans into the Tubby Custard Machine and out comes tasty, green Tubby Custard!

programme.title: Lets Do The Tubby
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like youve never seen them before!

programme.title: Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but its a little different than hes used to... hes going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum wont let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Caf in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal cars wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the teams downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kongs brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Mans father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Clouds successor as the citys guard.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the others mole.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: 恶战Once Upon a Time in Shanghai

programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 凡人修仙传The Immortal Ascension
programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Black S1 EP6
programme.desc: Di Seri Setia, Black dan Sofia bekerjasama untuk menghalang satu pembunuhan yang berpotensi untuk berlaku. Semasa berada di sana, Black terimbas kembali masa lalu Malik, satu fenomena yang membingungkannya. Pemergian mereka ini juga merupakan titik perubahan cara Sofia melihat keupayaannya. Kesanggupan Sofia menggadaikan nyawanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa orang lain memperbaharui tanggapan Black terhadapnya. Adakah cinta mula berputik? Black tertarik dan pada masa yang sama bingung dengan perasaannya terhadap Sofia, satu perasaan yang asing buat Black, seorang yang mementingkan diri. Tetapi hari yang bersinar menjadi pudar apabila Black kembali ke rumah dan mendapati bilik tersembunyi Malik telah digeledah dan dikosongkan. Sementara itu, pembunuh upahan telah meragut nyawa seorang lagi mangsa dan Detektif Borhan mendapati kematian itu ada kaitan dengan pembunuhan Nurul Najwa.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: Tiba dengan kereta api di Guangzhou pada tahun 1895, ketiga-tiga mereka melawan pengikut White Lotus, yang ingin membunuh semua orang asing dan Mak Cik ke-13 yang comel dan berpakaian Eropah. Ia bukanlah pertarungan terakhir pakar kung fu Dr. Wong Jet Li.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Wangi
programme.desc: Nor dan suaminya, Khuzairi tinggal di sebuah banglo bersama dua anak mereka. Selepas melahirkan anak kedua, Nor pulang ke rumah dan ibunya datang untuk menjaganya. Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. Nor mengesyaki dan tidak lama kemudian anak-anaknya mula mempunyai kelakuan luar biasa. Anak pertama mereka suka bercakap dengan dirinya sendiri dan tidur di tempat yang rawak suaminya menyembunyikan rahsia manakala seorang wanita tua sentiasa memberi amaran kepada Nor. Tanpa disedari oleh Nor, Bella yang hilang mungkin sedang mengintai di sudut gelap banglo itu.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP16
programme.desc: Bomoh mula memulakan upacara memanggil hantu Wan Peah. Pada ketika itu, Wan Peah sedang berehat di dalam rumah. Selepas terhidu bau ikan kering yang sangat kuat, dia terjaga dan terus mendapatkannya. Pintu rumah Wan Peah dibuka dan dia mula mengutip ikan-ikan kering yang tersusun hingga ke dalam hutan. Sebaik ternampak kelibat Wan Peah, bomoh memulakan membaca jampi mentera kononnya untuk menghalau roh jahat. Li, Ghani, Yeh, Cik Siti dan Aziz hanya melihat sahaja Wan Peah yang memandang pelik kearah mereka. Wan Peah menggeleng kepala langsung kembali pulang ke rumahnya.

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Di alam mimpi, Nabila dan Mary bertemu dengan orang yang berkongsi luka mereka, diri mereka semasa kecil. Rahsia terbongkar semasa zaman kanak-kanak mereka berjalan mereka ke lorong ingatan.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP2
programme.desc: McCall mendapati dirinya berada dalam ancaman agensi perisikan kerajaan asing apabila rakannya Mira, anak perempuan seorang diplomat, meminta bantuan McCall untuk mencari abangnya yang hilang.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP3
programme.desc: Memaparkan Rafeeq bertekad mahu menghapuskan Afifah, supaya dia bebas dari cengkaman Zacky. Zacky berkawan baik dengan Rizq, abang tiri kepada Afifah. Bapa Afifah minta tolong Zacky dan Rizq membantunya memulih Afifah yang kini lupa ingatan dan mengalami truama. Adelia masih marahkan Afifah yang menyebabkan abangnya Zacky mengalami tekanan selepas dia memutuskan hubungan dengan Zacky. Adelia kemudiannya ke rumah abangnya, malangnya dia telah dibunuh. Zacky kembali berbaik dengan Afifah setelah gadis tersebut meminta maaf. Tanpa mengetahui sebenar Zacky ialah pembunun misteri tersebut.

programme.title: Kanang Anak Langkau

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka

Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya

programme.title: Black S1 EP5
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh upahan sedang menjejakinya lalu Black menyedari masanya dalam badan Malik semakin suntuk. Dia mesti menamatkan misinya dengan cepat dan satu-satunya harapan yang dia ada adalah menyakinkan Sofia untuk membantunya. Dia terjumpa sebuah bilik rahsia di dalam rumah Malik di mana tersimpan barang-barang yang jelas sekali disorok oleh Malik. Sementara itu, Sofia nampak satu pembunuhan bakal berlaku yang mengganggu perasaannya sehingga merangsang dia untuk bertindak. Dia memujuk Black untuk pulang ke kampung halaman mereka di Seri Setia untuk menyiasat kes itu. Anehnya, penyiasatan Borhan ke atas kes Nurul Najwa juga membawanya ke Seri Setia. Di sana, dia ketemu semula rakan sekerja lamanya, yang menyimpan rahsia tentang kes dingin yang berlaku 20 tahun lalu.

programme.title: Black S1 EP6
programme.desc: Di Seri Setia, Black dan Sofia bekerjasama untuk menghalang satu pembunuhan yang berpotensi untuk berlaku. Semasa berada di sana, Black terimbas kembali masa lalu Malik, satu fenomena yang membingungkannya. Pemergian mereka ini juga merupakan titik perubahan cara Sofia melihat keupayaannya. Kesanggupan Sofia menggadaikan nyawanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa orang lain memperbaharui tanggapan Black terhadapnya. Adakah cinta mula berputik? Black tertarik dan pada masa yang sama bingung dengan perasaannya terhadap Sofia, satu perasaan yang asing buat Black, seorang yang mementingkan diri. Tetapi hari yang bersinar menjadi pudar apabila Black kembali ke rumah dan mendapati bilik tersembunyi Malik telah digeledah dan dikosongkan. Sementara itu, pembunuh upahan telah meragut nyawa seorang lagi mangsa dan Detektif Borhan mendapati kematian itu ada kaitan dengan pembunuhan Nurul Najwa.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II

programme.title: Wangi
programme.desc: Nor dan suaminya, Khuzairi tinggal di sebuah banglo bersama dua anak mereka. Selepas melahirkan anak kedua, Nor pulang ke rumah dan ibunya datang untuk menjaganya. Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. Nor mengesyaki dan tidak lama kemudian anak-anaknya mula mempunyai kelakuan luar biasa. Anak pertama mereka suka bercakap dengan dirinya sendiri dan tidur di tempat yang rawak suaminya menyembunyikan rahsia manakala seorang wanita tua sentiasa memberi amaran kepada Nor. programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Tuah

Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Magika

programme.title: Ruang Temu

programme.title: Terima Kasih Cikgu
programme.desc: Kisah Amar, seorang doktor yang ditugaskan di sebuah hospital. Suatu hari, Amar bertemu dengan bekas gurunya, Cikgu Azman. Selepas bersara, Cikgu Azman disahkan menghidap penyakit kanser. Amar cuba merawat gurunya sebaik mungkin.

programme.title: Temen Kondangan
programme.desc: Putri yang sering menghadiri majlis perkahwinan seorang diri akhirnya menyewa seorang lelaki untuk menjadi teman menghadiri majlis. Namun, hubungan yang pada mulanya sekadar lakonan bertukar menjadi lebih rumit apabila perasaan sebenar mula muncul.

programme.title: 7 Days24 Hours
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri, Tania dan Tyo, yang terlalu sibuk dengan kerjaya sehingga hubungan mereka semakin renggang. Selepas kedua-duanya jatuh sakit dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital yang sama, mereka akhirnya mempunyai masa bersama selama 7 hari 24 jam untuk memperbaiki hubungan, memahami satu sama lain dan menghadapi masalah yang selama ini dipendam.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: Dacademy 7
programme.desc: D Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai DAcademy musim ketujuh?

programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts,

programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of lifes major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties. Netizens will occasionally attend the show to share their own stories and ask questions of the guests and experts, making the topics more relevant and audience-focused!

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show Top Singers aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Every second counts in Show Biz to bring you with the most High Speed star news, exciting live shows and performers interviews.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Laus wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation.

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back?

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a marriage cooling-off period to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the worlds greatest fright.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kongs biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Chings wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Shadows Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: Eight years ago, the family in a Hakka-walled village was torn apart during a combative winter solstice dinner. Eight years later, their cousin returns home from England and seeks to reunite the family for another winter solstice dinner. While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

programme.title: My Wife is a Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: Natalie Yao Meng stars as the gambling queen, Ying Ying, who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition. But before the competition she is betrayed by her fianc and left for dead. Rescued by a young man called Gerrard, who suffering from amnesia, Ying Ying, must recover in time to compete in the big event!

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Veterinary assistant Zeming is pushed to the brink after a medical dispute. On the edge of life and death, he is drawn into a surreal realm of dreams and myth. Guided by a mysterious old man, he faces a brutal survival test, navigating illusion and reality in search of truth and awakening.

programme.title: Victims
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victims mother and the murderers mother as they uncover their sons hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: A young woman buys a vintage car that behaves oddly, only to discover its possessed by a vengeful spirit connected to her past.

programme.title: Vetrivel
programme.desc: Vetrivel and his friends kidnap a girl to help his brother unite with her, but their plan goes wrong, leading to messy and unexpected situations.

programme.title: Killadi Marumagan
programme.desc: Chaitu and Anu fall in love but their love is opposed by Anus mother, Shailaja Reddy, a woman who is determined to get her daughter married to the man of her choice.

programme.title: Ainthu Ainthu Ainthu
programme.desc: Aravind unexpectedly loses his beloved girlfriend in a car accident. The strangest thing happens after the accident when people around him tell him no such person ever existed.

programme.title: Regai
programme.desc: SI Vetri finds severed hands in an ice cart. A fingerprint links them to his friend Amuthan, believed dead. His probe exposes a medical trial cover-up staged as accidents.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: A young man struggles to find his place after moving in with his sister and her in-laws.

programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Kenyas growing human population is taking land and resources away from wildlife. The squeeze is creating increasing numbers of conflicts between humans and animals, and is one of the biggest issues in African conservation.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries

programme.title: 生活快易通
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的萬人美老師－郭昱晴擔任主持人以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流人間新聞此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任人間新聞報導的焦點包含慈善公益社會關懷文化藝術人文教育心靈提升健康醫療環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌

programme.title: 人生調色盤第285集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.title: 一樣的月光
programme.desc: 一樣的月光是1983年蘇芮首張個人專輯的主打歌，也是1983年台灣電影搭錯車的插曲1983年，新藝城的導演虞戡平策畫一部結合音樂與戲劇的電影搭錯車；這部電影描繪了7080年代台灣經濟高速成長，阿美一心想進入的歌舞影壇的故事此張專輯成功將電影主角的故事與音樂結合，是台灣首度以音樂影片（MV）的方式製作專輯當時虞戡平仍在尋找主角的幕後主唱，在電視上聽到蘇芮演唱西洋歌曲，音色相當不錯，便屬意她來擔任主唱專輯由李壽全製作，並找來羅大佑梁弘志等人寫曲一樣的月光歌詞承襲了羅大佑的風格，對社會現象的改變做出批判與反省，蘇芮獨特的嗓音也造就了黑色蘇芮的旋風是中文流行音樂史上

programme.title: 別再叫我外籍新娘

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第13季:第16集
programme.desc: 本集介紹三種生活科技：私酒電動自行車以及銀膠菊做成的濕式潛水服私酒是美國農民早年因應威士忌酒稅，自己用玉米釀造的非法烈酒，但現在有些酒廠開始取得資格，合法釀造私酒私酒的主要成份是玉米，熬煮出澱粉後，用發芽大麥分解出糖分，再由酵母發酵出酒精，然後多次蒸餾，提高酒精濃度，去除雜質，再加水調成適當濃度而成電動自行車提供輔助動力，讓使用者能輕鬆騎到時速45公里，一次充電可騎乘100公里，雖然造價高昂，為2500到5000美元不等，但仍是環保的新選擇主要生長在沙漠的灌木銀膠菊，樹皮中含有的乳膠液能在提煉純化後，做成性質類似氯丁橡膠的天然橡膠不像橡膠樹的橡膠含大量蛋白質，因此皮膚較不會有過敏反

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第13季:第17集
programme.desc: 本集介紹三種生活科技：水鋁石牛仔靴以及掃街車水鋁石是一種很稀有的水晶，近年來才被視為寶石，它的特性是在不同光線照射下會變色目前全世界只有土耳其密拉斯生產它，因為它的產量過少，難以專門為它開礦採集，因此只有在土耳其當地的鋁土礦裡，當成另一種產物它雖有特殊性質和稀少數量，但因不像鑽石那麼堅硬，因此純粹為裝飾用寶石牛仔靴是美國西部的象徵，但它出現的歷史，至少有1500年以上本集介紹德州一間家族傳承四代的牛仔靴工坊，他們仍用手工訂製牛仔靴，大至皮革種類，小至腳趾形狀，都能任由顧客選擇英國每年的街頭垃圾高達三千萬噸，因此掃街車成為打擊垃圾的利器位於英國肯特的金龜掃街車公司，每年生產40
